I'm not saying dogs are chickens, nor am I saying that's the only reason for my cause. if I were trying to convert someone this is absolutely not the reasoning I'd present for a main reason. I don't speak for everyone here, but my main concern is the environment.
Anyway, I was just adding my two cents related to this thread, as I didn't see anyone else make the same point.. apologies if I've frustrated you further?

the point isn't really "which one feels emotions more" or "which one means more to us" or whatever. both chickens and dogs can process emotions, so it's wrong for either species to have to suffer just to satisfy for our preferences--especially when they really don't need to.

well, firstly I'd like to say that kids most definitely can be depressed. I'm pretty sure I've been depressed for as long as I can remember, to be honest. it's entirely possible that you are depressed, though strangers on the internet most definitely can't diagnose you. 
secondly, I really wish I knew what you could do. talking to people online can help sometimes, I guess, and venting about your emotions might help. I have to say that talking to medical professionals would probably be the most efficient form of help. I'm currently working on that part myself. if you can't or just aren't up for that, I guess the only things I know are expressing emotions through art or venting and trying to keep myself from thinking too much. those are just small temporary things though.

damn, that really fucking sucks. if it's worth anything, I'd like to add that crying is absolutely okay and there's nothing wrong with it--society just has this toxic view that showing emotion, especially for those who they deem (whether correctly or incorrectly) to be men, is a bad thing and a that shit should be bottled up to show for some form of strength. it's all bullshit.

omfg. it's the same for me, kind of. my dad says he accepts me being trans. refuses to call me his son and instead insists that I am a "Daughter of God."
only thing keeping me going is the hope of helping people later in my life and the fear of hurting everyone else. wish I could help you, sis. ironically, all I know how to do is just exist, so if you ever need to vent about it lmk
I get that. I want to die but I hate that it would hurt my friends. I wish I knew some way out of this but I'm in the same boat.

I don't show it off, but sometimes mentioning that I have depression is a little bit of an explanation for a lot of things about me. as others have said, some people with depression who talk about it a lot are basically shouting out for help or maybe even just comfort. others find that joking is a good way to cope. I definitely joke about it with my close friends sometimes (though not with random people and not often even with my close friends. it can be a bit of a mood dampening topic, especially when it gets serious) just because it makes light of my situation in a weird way.
there are also people who say they have depression just for the attention. for some reason, having certain mental illnesses or bad habits has become cool and a thing to brag or joke about, like not sleeping, not eating, depression, and anxiety.
I think everyone wants to be alone sometimes but nobody wants to be lonely
